description: Preview build of Metasequoia IME (MSIME), the free and open-source Chinese input method for Windows, published from the main msime repository.
##: scoop update runs the uninstaller hook of the old manifest before installing the new version (scoop-update.ps1), and the vendor uninstaller deletes the user data directory, so the uninstaller hook returns early when Scoop's $cmd is 'update'.
notes: This is the Windows preview release, versioned separately from the stable Windows build packaged as 'msime'.
It installs next to 'msime' in its own program and data directories as a separate TSF input method, so both can be installed at the same time.
The setup registers a TSF input method for all users, so installing and uninstalling both need administrator rights and raise a UAC prompt.

This package only wraps the official setup: program files go to %ProgramFiles%\metasequoiaime-full and the TSF DLLs to %SystemRoot%\System32%\IME\metasequoiaime-full, outside the Scoop apps directory.

User data (settings, learned words, skins) is kept in %LOCALAPPDATA%\metasequoiaime-full. 'scoop update' and the vendor uninstaller both keep it, and 'scoop uninstall --purge' does not remove it either.
The setup is Authenticode-signed by 'Open Source Developer LU FAN' (SignPath Foundation); Scoop only verifies the SHA256, so check the signature if you need that guarantee too.
The x64 Microsoft Visual C++ 2015-2022 Redistributable is required; without it the server exits and the input method cannot be turned on.
Press Win+Space to switch to the input method after installing.

script: if (!$setup) { abort 'The Metasequoia IME preview setup was not downloaded.' }
$exitCodes = @{ 3010 = 'A restart is required to finish the installation.' }

if (!(Invoke-ExternalCommand -FilePath $setup.FullName -ArgumentList '/VERYSILENT', '/SUPPRESSMSGBOXES', '/NORESTART', '/SP-' -Activity 'Running the Metasequoia IME preview setup' -RunAs -ContinueExitCodes $exitCodes)) { abort 'The Metasequoia IME preview setup failed.' }
Write-Host 'Skipping the vendor uninstaller during update: it would delete %LOCALAPPDATA%\metasequoiaime-full.'
$exitCodes = @{ 3010 = 'A restart is required to finish the uninstallation.' }

if ($uninstaller -and !(Invoke-ExternalCommand -FilePath $uninstaller.FullName -ArgumentList '/VERYSILENT', '/SUPPRESSMSGBOXES', '/NORESTART', '/KEEPDATA' -Activity 'Running the Metasequoia IME preview uninstaller' -RunAs -ContinueExitCodes $exitCodes)) { abort 'The Metasequoia IME preview uninstaller failed.' }
